name: Chloe St. James
source:
Chloe is abrasive and rude to those she feels are beneath her. Because she is ranked #2 in the student list, she believes she is entitled to the same preferential treatment as Poppy Min-Sinclair and considers herself to be second-in-command after Poppy.

[spoiler]Chloe is the middle child in her family and, as such, feels constantly overlooked by others. She feels confident in her dancing, and was captain of her high school cheerleading squad as well as three-time national champion; however, Poppy's ego and her desire to be the star of the Zeta dance team have allowed Chloe little time in the team's spotlight.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Chloe_St._James]Wiki[/url]]
